title: Count equally likely outcomes, not categories
concept: Each marble (or ball) is equally likely to be picked, not each colour. So count marbles, not colours.
Probability = (marbles that fit) ÷ (ALL the marbles). It is a number from 0 to 1, never more than 1.

alternative.title: Number the objects
text: Give every marble a number: each number is equally likely, so count numbers that fit.

members.title: Balls of different counts: each ball is equally likely
